newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 366-day bills average accepted yield 5.62 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 366-day bills average accepted yield 5.62 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 366-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 5.62 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority said.
This compares with 12-month HIBOR of 6.26923 percent at 0300 GMT and an average accepted yield of 5.77 percent at the last monthly tender of one-year bills on September 3.
Bids for the HK$500 million issue fell to HK$2.61 billion from the previous HK$3.37 billion.
The average accepted yield of 92-day bills was 5.19 percent, against three-month HIBOR of 5.64904 percent and the average accepted yield of 5.20 percent at last week's tender.
Bids for the HK$1.50 billion issue rose to HK$7.71 billion from HK$4.41 billion.
